metadata.question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Active Fire Detection points (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) filtered to Brazil (USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017) for the years 2007 and 2019. If one year is empty, fall back to MODIS/061/MCD14DL.
2. Masking: Not applicable for point detections (no cloud masking).
3. Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: If either year has 0 detections after fallback, output C1. If counts are null/NaN, output C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Brazil'))
      .geometry();

    const yearA = {label: '2007', start: '2007-01-01', end: '2007-12-31'};
    const yearB = {label: '2019', start: '2019-01-01', end: '2019-12-31'};

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (try primary then fallback)
    const candidates = ['MODIS/006/MCD14DL', 'MODIS/061/MCD14DL'];

    async function countForDataset(ds) {
      const fcA = ee.FeatureCollection(ds).filterBounds(brazil).filterDate(yearA.start, yearA.end);
      const fcB = ee.FeatureCollection(ds).filterBounds(brazil).filterDate(yearB.start, yearB.end);
      const nA = await fcA.size().getInfo();
      const nB = await fcB.size().getInfo();
      return {dataset: ds, nA, nB};
    }

    let result = null;
    for (const ds of candidates) {
      const r = await countForDataset(ds);
      // Accept dataset if both years have >0 detections
      if (typeof r.nA === 'number' && typeof r.nB === 'number' && r.nA > 0 && r.nB > 0) {
        result = r;
        break;
      }
      // Keep the last attempt in case both zero to decide on C1
      result = r;
    }

    // 3. Validation and handling empty collections
    if (result == null) {
      console.log('No dataset evaluated.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const {dataset, nA, nB} = result;

    if (nA == null || nB == null || isNaN(nA) || isNaN(nB)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
      console.log('Calculation result invalid (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    if (nA === 0 || nB === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`${yearA.label} Fires: ${nA}`);
      console.log(`${yearB.label} Fires: ${nB}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Compute comparison and print concise evidence
    const diff = nB - nA;
    const ratio = nA > 0 ? (nB / nA) : null;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`${yearA.label} Fire detections: ${nA}`);
    console.log(`${yearB.label} Fire detections: ${nB}`);
    console.log(`Diff (2019-2007): ${diff}  Ratio: ${ratio !== null ? ratio.toFixed(3) : 'n/a'}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    // Question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?
    // Yes -> A, No -> B
    if (ratio === null) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (nB < nA) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected dataset/method errors -> D
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
